set.body:
Outcome

Rebuild the pending exact atlas publication work on the greenfield image contract before it is merged. Use direct image4s-locus GridDomain identity and authoritative locus4s PartialSurjection values; do not preserve a ScalaFIM VolumeDomain or legacy ordinal bridge.

Prerequisite

Complete the semantic mask, label, cluster, and parcel-map core task bd-01M0QG2WT1MEQR8HD4P38Y07N9.

Work

- Preserve AtlasQuotient and AtlasPublication concepts that add atlas metadata, display order, hierarchy, provenance, and neutral Neuropublish realizations.
- Bind volume realizations directly to the canonical image4s GridDomain record and typed voxel field.
- Bind surface realizations to exact ordered topology identity.
- Carry one exact ordered parcel FiniteDomain and one authoritative PartialSurjection.
- Derive dense categorical label images, regions, fibers, and parcel fields on demand.
- Split or rebuild commit 143e6ae7 so no legacy VolumeOrdinalBridge, first-axis-fastest domain, or compatibility export is merged.
- Keep persistent identities versioned, content-derived, and language-neutral.

Acceptance

- No persistent identity uses runtime hashCode or historical ScalaFIM ordinal order.
- Same-sized foreign or reordered grids and parcel domains fail without certified alignment.
- Volume and surface realizations share a parcel domain only by exact ordered identity or explicit Bijection.
- Schaefer variants, foreign-producer protocol fixtures, tamper, coverage, provenance, grid, topology, and JVM or Scala.js suites pass.
- The resulting atlas slice can be reviewed and merged independently of abandoned compatibility code.

Non-goal

No second generic Domain, Field, Region, Selection, Parcellation, registry, or volume-order algebra in scalafim-atlas.
set.title: Rebase exact atlas realizations onto direct GridDomain and PartialSurjection
